subject: MAP: Sprint plan & provisioning checklist for MedSyst POC
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsyst.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-18 09:12 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and POC environment details

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. To get our evaluation started we need a mutual action plan that covers environment provisioning details: org invites, API keys with appropriate scopes, IP allowlist entries for our test clients, and VPC peering to our Azure tenant. Ideal POC window is 2/24 - 3/09. Can you outline owners and a sprint timeline?

I attached a short requirements spreadsheet with the services we plan to exercise.

Attachment: POC-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Cheers,
Alex Johnson
Director, Platform Engineering
MedSyst Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsyst.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-18 12:03 -0800
Subject: MAP: Sprint plan & provisioning checklist for MedSyst POC

Alex — thanks for the spreadsheet. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a short provisioning checklist. High level proposal below (two-week technical evaluation + 1 week ramp):

Sprint milestones (owners):
- Day 0 (owners: Tessa / Karthik): Kickoff call to confirm scope and test prompts. Proposed: 2026-02-19 10:00 PT.
- Day 1-2 (owners: Diego): Org & project setup — invite service account, create evaluation org, create initial API key with limited scopes (read/generate), provide key rotation guidance.
- Day 2-5 (owners: Diego + MedSyst infra): IP allowlist entries on Redwood side; customer to provide public IPs/subnets.
- Day 3-7 (owners: Diego / MedSyst infra): VPC peering handshake. We will provide peering acceptance steps and a small NAT/bastion recommendation.
- Day 8-14 (owners: Karthik): Run load/latency profiles, assist with quantization/settings to meet your latency SLOs.
- Ongoing (owner: Priya): Security evidence exchange and KMS discussion.

Key asks from MedSyst today:
1) Confirm kickoff time.
2) Share two public IPs or CIDR ranges to allowlist and your Azure VNet CIDR + ASN if peering required.
3) Any compliance docs we should prepare now (SOC2, specific contract SAs).

Attachments: RDW_MAP_MedSyst_v1.pdf (MAP draft)
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/RDW-2026-0421

If this aligns I will create a calendar invite and open a technical ticket for VPC peering.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>, Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsyst.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-19 08:40 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Sprint plan & provisioning checklist for MedSyst POC

Alex, Tessa — quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff:
- For VPC peering we need the customer VNet CIDR and preferred peering subnet (avoid 10.0.0.0/8 conflicts).
- We recommend at minimum: two public egress IPs to allowlist, and an internal CIDR for routing (we can NAT if needed).
- Please decide if you want shared API keys for the team or per-service keys; per-service keys are easier to revoke during the POC.
- I will enable flow logs on our side for the session window and share a temporary support tunnel approach if you want to push larger test payloads.

I will prep the peering template and a short runbook for acceptance steps.

Diego
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsyst.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-19 09:15 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Sprint plan & provisioning checklist for MedSyst POC

Thanks Diego — answers below:
- Azure VNet CIDR: 10.55.0.0/16 (primary), peer at 10.55.128.0/17 if you prefer.
- Public IPs to allowlist: 34.201.45.12, 52.14.233.9.
- We prefer per-service API keys for auditability.

Kickoff confirmed for 2026-02-19 10:00 PT. Procurement: our legal team needs the MAP and a short statement of data handling for the POC; I loop Laura Kim (CFO) for budget sign-off.

Alex
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsyst.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-20 14:06 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Sprint plan & provisioning checklist for MedSyst POC

Alex — looping in the security checklist you asked for. For the POC we will provide:
- SOC 2 Type II report excerpt and summary of controls.
- Data retention and deletion plan for POC data; we propose 30-day retention and guaranteed deletion on request.
- KMS integration notes: we support BYOK via your KMS provider; we'll send a short integration guide.

Attached: security-evidence-request.pdf (list of minimal artifacts and timelines). If anything is sensitive, we can move the exchange to a signed SFTP or secure file link.

Priya
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsyst.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-23 16:20 -0800
Subject: MAP: Sprint plan & provisioning checklist for MedSyst POC — confirmed

Alex / team — thanks for the quick responses. Finalizing the MAP with the following commitments:
- Kickoff: 2026-02-19 10:00 PT (completed).
- Org & API keys: Diego to provision per-service keys by 2026-02-20 EOD.
- IP allowlist: added 34.201.45.12 and 52.14.233.9 to the evaluation org firewall; please confirm connectivity.
- VPC peering: template sent, pending your acceptance and route validation (target completion 2026-02-22).
- Security artifacts: Priya to provide SOC2 excerpt + KMS guide by 2026-02-24.
- POC window: 2026-02-24 through 2026-03-09. Performance review and close discussion scheduled 2026-03-10.

Next steps for MedSyst: confirm peering accept and validate API keys. For Redwood: we will standby for any test data and share a small prompt set for quality checks.

Attachments: RDW_MAP_MedSyst_v1.pdf

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
